app.name: Cairn
app.recoveryDescription: The main vault is missing. Close Cairn and restore backups/previous.cairn in the vault folder.
auth.createDescription: Choose a master password of at least 12 characters. It can't be reset.
auth.unlockDescription: Enter your master password to open the vault.
errors.Storage: Couldn't read or save the vault. Check disk space and permissions, then unlock it again.
errors.InUse: The vault is already open in another instance of Cairn.
errors.AlreadyExists: A vault already exists. Unlock it to continue.
errors.Locked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to continue.
errors.InvalidInput: Check the fields and their length. The master password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.InvalidVault: The vault file is damaged or its format is invalid. It was not replaced.
errors.UnsupportedVersion: This vault needs another version of Cairn.
errors.Randomness: Windows couldn't generate the random data Cairn needs. Try again.
errors.ChangedOnDisk: The vault changed on disk. Lock it and unlock it again before continuing.
entry.name: Name
entry.siteHint: Filled on this exact site. Write *.example.com to include its subdomains.
entry.notesUnchanged: The notes stay unchanged. Show the password before editing to change them.
entry.totpHint: The setup key or otpauth:// link a site gives when you turn on two-factor authentication.
entry.needsSecret: Enter a password, an authenticator key, or both.
entry.invalid: Check the fields. An authenticator key is a Base32 key or an otpauth://totp link.
